name: Sheraton Bratislava Hotel
positioning: Riverside city hotel on the banks of the Danube in Bratislava, part of a shopping boulevard with a promenade, a five-minute walk from the city center, with Eurovea at its doorstep and a wellness area with a swimming pool, sauna and steam room
best_for: City travelers who want a Danube-side base a five-minute walk from the city center, with Eurovea and the Slovak National Theatre close by
Families who want playgrounds and parks on the Danube promenade just steps away

facts.text: The hotel is a five-minute walk from the city center.
The Slovak National Theatre's new building, which hosts opera and ballet, is steps away.
The bathrooms are spacious and oversized, with both a rainfall shower and a bathtub.
All rooms have plush pillowtop beds and upscale bathrooms.
The presidential suite includes a terrace with river views.
The fitness center is open to hotel guests 24/7 and is equipped with Life Fitness cardiovascular and toning devices.
Amber's Bar hosts wine tastings and after-work drinks.
Outdoor playgrounds, climbing walls and green parks on the Danube promenade are just steps from the hotel.
The Natural History Museum, with a life-sized mammoth, is a walk down the Danube promenade.
Taxis and cars can drop off and pick up directly in front of the main entrance, and valet parking is available.

highlights.text: The hotel is on the banks of the Danube River, as part of a shopping boulevard with a promenade and entertainment, cultural and relaxing venues.
Eurovea, Slovakia's largest shopping destination, is right at the hotel's doorstep.
Selected 5th-floor rooms and suites have access to an outdoor terrace with a plaza and river view.
The hotel's wellness area has a relaxation loungers zone, a swimming pool, a sauna and a steam room, just steps from the rooms.

considerations.text: Hotel guests pay a small extra charge to use the wellness area.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the business-focused atmosphere may lack resort-style leisure amenities.
